name: Journey
description: Quest and story framework with tasks, zones, timelines, flags, parties, bounties, markers, NPC paths, cutscenes, and player backpacks.

name: Wonder
description: Queued Wonder Trade channels that match submitted party or PC Pokémon with another player or a configured pool.

name: Bazaar
description: Pokémon fixed-price listings plus an item Auction House with bidding, anti-snipe handling, collection storage, and market history.

name: Smart Trainers (SmartAI)
description: Configurable trainer AI that evaluates moves, switches, items, priorities, prediction, personalities, battle bags, and optional battle gimmicks.

name: Bloom
description: Physical and personal lure system with type, species, form, rarity, spawn-rate, shiny, and hidden-ability targeting.

name: Colosseum
description: Single-player facilities for staged Tower, Factory, and Arcade runs with party validation, checkpoints, streaks, and configured rewards.

name: EEssentials
description: Modular server commands for messaging, homes, teleports, warps, random teleport, playtime, and virtual workstations.

name: CobbleWorkers
description: Pasture Block jobs let assigned Pokémon gather, harvest, irrigate, fish, heal, generate resources, and perform other utility work.

name: Cobblemon Extras
description: Server-side Pokémon inspection, sharing, trading, battling, showcase, PC, IV, and utility commands.

name: Cobblemon Flan Integration
description: Connects Pokémon actions to Flan claims so owners and staff can control spawning, catching, battling, sending out, riding, and display-case interaction.

name: SkiesGUIs
description: Server-driven inventory menus with aliases, item actions, requirements, placeholders, and economy integrations.

name: Universal Daily Rewards
description: Daily and playtime reward calendars with cooldowns, streaks, multiple pages, and configured reward screens.

name: NeoPlushies
description: Collectible plushie and reward-voucher system documented by the server's existing field-guide data.
